issues.description: The problem statement (UML) requires the Lecture constructor parameters in the order: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. The reference solution implements a constructor with a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch contradicts the explicit instruction to follow the UML parameter order and will confuse students implementing the constructor and may cause tests that check parameter order to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML/problem statement. Change the constructor signature in the solution (and any tests) to: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... } and assign fields accordingly. Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to clearly reflect the constructor parameter order used in the solution if that order is intended.

issues.description: The problem statement and UML require the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the attribute order from the UML (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution's Lecture constructor declares parameters in a different order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch between the specified API order and the solution implementation can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and the mapping between parameters and attributes.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution constructor signature to follow the UML-specified order: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign parameters to fields accordingly. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to reflect the constructor order used in the solution if that order was intentional.
